I was never able to pinpoint a particular ingredient in any of the lotions that may have been causing it, so I decided to go with this one-ingredient product. reviews.t: This oil is great! We bought it after having a baby and ...
reviews.x: This oil is great!  We bought it after having a baby and use it on so many things.  It is great for diaper changes, cradle cap, and baby massage.  Love that it is organic.  It smells like fresh coconuts and has a very smooth texture when applying.  My wife uses on her skin (perfect for dry skin in winter) and hair too and says that it could be used on stretch marks as well.  Would even recommend it during pregnancy for preventing stretch marks as well.

reviews.t: My 2 month old daughter was suffering from severe dry skin and everything else was just making it worse. Within minutes
reviews.x: I received a sample of UpSpring Baby in a baby sample box I had from Target. My 2 month old daughter was suffering from severe dry skin and everything else was just making it worse. Within minutes of using this it started to clear up!
I was really skeptical that this would work for my hair and skin. I love it, it isn't greasy and my skin and hair feel softer.

I love this product. I came across it while I was searching for something to help my 9 month old son's eczema. It's really moisturizing and smells amazing!! He no longer has dry patches, it has worked wonders for us! Highly recommend!

Love it!! My goddaughter used this for her eczema and we've noticed significant improvements in her skin. I replaced my lotion for this coconut oil on my skin. I receive lots of compliments that my fragrance smells good! Funny, how the natural oil works better than the fancy creams and lotions. The jar also does a great job of containing the oil. It doesn't seep out or sweat in my bathroom because of the humidity. I will repurchase this product in the near future.

This is the best product I have used for diaper rash or dry skin. My 9 month old had diaper rash and I tried every diaper rash cream I could find and nothing help. I received a trail sample of this in a baby box and it cleared up in 2 uses. I ordered a full size and love it. Only problem is it will melt in 100 degree heat when left on your porch, just bring it inside and let it cool back off.

I'm a huge fan of UpSpring's coconut oil!  In my last month of pregnancy, I developed a severe case of PUPPP and lathering on this coconut oil seems to be one of the few things I could do to help stem the itching.  It also smells great (although you have to like the smell of coconut to begin with).  I've tried other brands of coconut oil to help with PUPPP and this one seems to work the best!

reviews.x: My son is constantly scratching his face when he’s tired and made one of his cheeks super rough. He’s 5 months now. So I got him some big infant mittens and this coconut oil and saw the difference after just one day of use! Absolutely love this and so happy I got it! Also smells exactly like coconut (:
I really like this product, but when I received it, it seemed that it was only half full. Has anyone else had this problem. I really don't like to be cheated.
I use this for everything! I originally bought for my daughters cradle cap, which it worked amazingly for, and now I use it for my hair as well. I love this!
I really love the way my cuticles are looking & feeling after using the product.
used this since the baby was born, it’s great. No diaper rash, no chemicals.

I purchased a sample of this product and loved it so much that I got the full size version. I love the smell of it. Initially it's overpowering to me but it mellows out nicely rather quickly. I've been using this on my infant's hair. He has 4a-4c hair and it keeps it moisturized and soft. Initially I was using Castor Oil on his hair and it seemed to dry his hair out over time but this is perfect for him. I just spritz his hair with water, and then apply the oil on it and it keeps it soft all day

I LOVE this coconut oil! I’m very particular about what I put on my skin (non gmo, gluten-free and vegan) and so I looked for a cold-pressed lotion to make sure it had minimal processing.  I have used it on pretty much everything so far from my face, to my body and even on my growing belly.  *Fingers crossed no stretch marks!*  I will definitely be buying this again.

Was very surprised by this product! I have recently started using more natural products to try and eliminate all the chemicals and was skeptical about coconut oil for skin but I have to say I am very surprised how well this stuff works.  A little goes a long way! Love the smell too, definitely will be purchasing again.

I love this coconut oil! I use it on my son after every bath and it leaves his skin so soft. The coconut oil absorbs into his skin and doesn't leave him oily. I also use it very time I change his diaper and it works great for diaper rash.

reviews.t: Great product. Nothing bad to say
reviews.x: Great product. Nothing bad to say. Just wish it was easier to open and close but thats the nature of putting oil on your hands then trying to close a jar tigh enough where it wont leak.
I was not sure when I ordered this product. However, it is worth the money. My hair is soft as ever and the coconut oil blends well with other essential oils.  I just ordered two more.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the coconut oil for relieving dry skin, eczema, and itchy skin, often noting fast results.
Many customers find it effective for baby care, including diaper rash, cradle cap, and baby massage.
Several reviewers love the coconut scent and smooth, non-greasy texture.
A few customers complain that the product is not creamier than plain coconut oil or that the container arrived only half full.
Some reviewers value that it is organic and a simple one-ingredient product suitable for sensitive skin.
